THE PARLOUR / TAKE YOUR TIME

Rings Leave Ripples

Move a ring to leave a marker and flip crossed marker runs; scoring removes one of your own future movement bases.

Restart this deal
Another deal

A THOUGHTFUL LITTLE MATCH

Find your next move.

Choose ring origin that seeds a row while its landing enables a future crossing, flip an enemy threat without creating a stronger rival row elsewhere, choose which scoring markers/ring to remove to preserve future movement options. Scoring voluntarily reduces your mobile sources; greedy immediate row can leave a weaker remaining ring position.

Take a seat
How to play
Hexagonal radius3 board,37 intersections. Alternate placing four own rings on empty cells, then movement phase. On turn choose own ring, leave own marker on its origin, move along a straight hex axis. May cross any empty intersections before markers; after first marker must cross entire contiguous marker run and stop at first empty intersection. Cannot cross another ring. All crossed markers flip owner; empty-to-empty move allowed. Any four collinear consecutive same-owner markers create scoring row. Resolve every row before next move: row owner selects four consecutive markers to remove, then removes one own ring permanently and gains one seal. If both sides have rows, mover resolves their own first; removing markers can break rival row. Multiple own rows resolve one at a time with choice. Victory immediately at third seal.
First three seals wins; house three loses. If current player has no legal ring move before three seals, opponent wins. Threefold full-position repetition draws;100 completed ring moves without third seal draws with no score-based shortcut.
Controls & access
The important decisions

No timer. No account. A fresh approach is always welcome.

Scoring order

Four consecutive markers along any hex axis score a seal. Mover resolves their rows first. Select one row, remove its four markers, then permanently retire one own ring. Recheck rows after each removal; the third seal wins immediately.

Travel

Move along one straight hex axis. You may stop in empty space before crossing markers. After entering a contiguous marker run you must cross it and stop at the first empty intersection. Rings block travel. Origin receives your marker; all crossed markers flip.

How to play
Hexagonal radius3 board,37 intersections. Alternate placing four own rings on empty cells, then movement phase. On turn choose own ring, leave own marker on its origin, move along a straight hex axis. May cross any empty intersections before markers; after first marker must cross entire contiguous marker run and stop at first empty intersection. Cannot cross another ring. All crossed markers flip owner; empty-to-empty move allowed. Any four collinear consecutive same-owner markers create scoring row. Resolve every row before next move: row owner selects four consecutive markers to remove, then removes one own ring permanently and gains one seal. If both sides have rows, mover resolves their own first; removing markers can break rival row. Multiple own rows resolve one at a time with choice. Victory immediately at third seal.
First three seals wins; house three loses. If current player has no legal ring move before three seals, opponent wins. Threefold full-position repetition draws;100 completed ring moves without third seal draws with no score-based shortcut.
